base: Historical scene illustration, South England market town 1400–1450. Match attached project reference paintings in hand-painted low-chroma tempera/gouache natural narrative realism, warm plaster, weathered oak, muted clay roofs. Reference sheet style only: produce ONE full bleed scene, never sheet or labels. NO lettering, numerals, pseudo-text, watermark, border, parchment tint, real heraldry, domestic chimneys, plague door marks, hops, hexagonal coffins, gore. Any documents completely blank.
